This [[quest]] gives a [[character]] access to the [[Eye of the North]] expansion. 

== Quest information ==
=== Requirements ===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = Prophecies
| nationality = all
| minimum = 10
| transfer = Eye of the North
| complete = Neither [[I Feel the Earth Move Under Cantha's Feet]] nor [[Hole of Istan]]
}}

=== Objectives ===
* Investigate the earthquake aftermath in [[North Kryta Province]].
* Enter the [[crevasse]].
* Investigate the [[Beneath Lion's Arch|Depths beneath North Kryta Province]].

=== Reward ===
* 2,500 [[Experience]]

=== Environmental changes ===
Once this quest, [[Hole of Istan]] or [[I Feel the Earth Move Under Cantha's Feet]] has been completed, the crevasse, [[fissure]] and [[chasm]] become permanent [[interactive object]]s of their respective [[explorable area]]s.

== Walkthrough ==
The crevasse that you must get to is just slightly north from [[Lion's Arch]]. It is to the east of [[Miraba]] and [[Leighton Cranford]]. Click on the crevasse and choose to enter. You will be brought to [[Beneath Lion's Arch]]. Follow the path through the small cavern and into the ancient hall, killing some [[undead]] along the way. Keep going on the singular path until you see [[dwarven]] allies. Climb up the stairs and a [[cinematic]] will begin. [[The Beginning of the End]] is the follow-up [[primary quest]] that is automatically added to your [[quest log]].

=== Recommended skills ===
* Any skill that deals [[holy damage]] is effective against the undead found in [[Beneath Lion's Arch]].

== Dialogue ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
; Len Caldoron
: ''Did you feel the earth shake, <Character name>? I was working my fields when the ground began to quake furiously, sort of like my wife does when I leave my dirty socks on the dining room table.... Suddenly, the dirt around me swelled up and collapsed, leaving a giant '''crevasse''' in its place. I thought I heard voices, so I looked inside for survivors. I couldn't make out any faces but swear I saw shapes moving in the dust-filled darkness. I ran as fast as I could. Please, you must go back and '''investigate''' this catastrophe!''

== Notes ==
* This quest concludes automatically at the end of the cinematic; the follow-up quest, [[the Beginning of the End]], is automatically accepted.
* If you are below level 20 you will be buffed by [[Journey to the North]] within the [[Eye of the North]] expansion.
* If you have any of the other Eye of the North access quests in your [[Quest Log]], finishing one will remove them from your Quest Log.
* Anomaly: Doesn't work when the quest "Evil Residents" is active
